title: 見
teacherNotes: Teacher-approved final source for L180 見. Latest origin/main was rechecked after production work and is complete through L178 聲, so L180 depends on not-yet-merged L179 聽 before production JSON may merge. Provisional learned chars after recomputing against latest origin/main are 聽 only. Do not merge production JSON, planner-data, or ledger until L179 is present in latest origin/main. Use Taiwan Traditional Chinese and Taiwan zhuyin only. Images must be square 1:1 compositions using L058 style anchors, with no text, numbers, signs, letters, zhuyin, labels, logos, or watermarks. Audio must be standalone OpenAI charAudio, whole-sentence AI audio, independent G02 prefix/suffix from exact fragments, and independent G05 wrong-choice whole-sentence audio.

approvedSentences.text: 小馬不見了，我叫大家一起找。
approvedSentences.spokenText: 小馬不見了我叫大家一起找
approvedSentences.imageNotes: 可愛小馬不見了，固定的「我」小女孩叫大家一起找小馬。畫面要清楚呈現大家在安全草地或家附近尋找小馬，不可有文字、數字或標籤。

approvedSentences.text: 一邊聽著雨聲，一邊看書。
approvedSentences.spokenText: 一邊聽著雨聲一邊看書
approvedSentences.imageNotes: 孩子在窗邊或室內安靜看書，同時聽著外面的雨聲。畫面可見窗外下雨和孩子看書，不可有書本文字、數字或標籤。

approvedSentences.text: 風聲好大，什麼都聽不見了。
approvedSentences.spokenText: 風聲好大什麼都聽不見了
approvedSentences.imageNotes: 外面風很大，孩子或家人摀著耳朵或露出聽不清楚的表情。畫面要表現風聲很大、聽不見，不要做成危險災難場景；不可有文字、數字或標籤。
固定的「我」小女孩聽到有人叫她，回頭或四處看，像是在找誰叫她。不可有對話框文字、數字或標籤。
安全交通教學情境，孩子看見紅燈後停下來等待。畫面要清楚呈現紅燈與停下來；紅燈、路邊和車輛不可有文字、數字、路牌或車牌標籤。

stage4Plan.reason: 看見紅燈 is the core use of 見 in this lesson.
